title: Deletion You Can Check: Auditing LLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A common indication that a fine-tuned model has forgotten a deleted record is a membership-inference score near chance (ROC-AUC $\approx 0.5$). This reading is sound only if the comparison population represents how the record should behave after a valid deletion---a counterfactual that is rarely validated. We test this premise in a controlled $2\times2$ study pairing two membership-inference benchmarks, ArxivMIA and BookMIA, with two language models, Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen2.5-1.5B. Exact retraining validates the membership reference: it lies within the prespecified chance band on ArxivMIA but reaches $0.122$ on BookMIA, causing the same metric to reject an empirical deletion reference. A post-hoc BookMIA/Qwen diagnostic replaces benchmark label-0 records with same-pool, never-fine-tuned records and moves the reference from $0.257$ to $0.523$, supporting population mismatch in that cell. translated_title: 可验证的删除：审计大语言模型的“遗忘”（Unlearning）
translated_abstract: 微调后的模型已成功遗忘某条被删除记录的一个常见判断依据，是成员推理得分接近随机水平（ROC-AUC ≈ 0.5）。只有当用于比较的参照群体能够代表该记录在有效删除后应有的表现时，这种解读才成立——而这一反事实情形很少得到验证。我们在一个受控的 2×2 研究中检验了这一前提，将两个成员推理基准（ArxivMIA 和 BookMIA）与两个语言模型（Llama-3.2-1B 和 Qwen2.5-1.5B）配对。以精确重训练作为金标准来验证成员推理参照：在 ArxivMIA 上参照位于预设的随机带内，但在 BookMIA 上达到 0.122，使得同一指标拒绝了经验性的删除参照。一项针对 BookMIA/Qwen 组合的事后诊断将基准中标签为 0 的记录替换为同池中从未参与微调的记录，使参照从 0.257 移动到 0.523，从而证实了该单元中存在参照群体不匹配的问题。每个近似遗忘的检查点都被联合评判……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文指出，业界常用的“成员推理得分接近随机（ROC-AUC ≈ 0.5）即代表遗忘成功”这一审计标准，依赖于极少被验证的参照群体假设，并通过 2×2 对照实验（结合精确重训练金标准与事后诊断）证明基准参照群体的不匹配会导致对大模型删除/遗忘效果的错误判断，从而提出了一套更可靠的遗忘审计方法。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the common audit practice of treating a chance-level membership-inference score (ROC-AUC ≈ 0.5) as evidence of successful LLM unlearning is only valid if the reference population is sound, and through a controlled 2×2 study with exact retraining and post-hoc diagnostics demonstrates that benchmark population mismatch (e.g., on BookMIA) can invalidate deletion audits.
